name: Special South Gate City Council
minutes_text:
CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  JANUARY  27, 2026

CALL  TO ORDER  Joshua Barron,  Mayor  called  a Special  City  Council  Meeting  to order at
  5:30 p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Joshua Barron,  Vice Mayor  Al Rios,  Council  Member  Maria  del
  PilarAvalos,  Council  Member  Maria  Davila  and Council  Member  Gil
  Hurtado;  City  Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, City  Manager  Rob Houston,  City
  Attorney  Raul F. Salinas

1

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued  a Proclamation  declaring  the month  of January
  2026,  as National  Slavery  and Human  Trafficking  Prevention  month  in the
  City  of South  Gate.

2

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued  a Proclamation  declaring  the month  of January
  2026, as National  Mental  Wellness  Month

3
PERSONNEL  RF.CRUITMENT

& SELECTION  The City  Council  received  and filed  the list of new and promoted  full-time
  employees  hired  or promoted  during  November  and December  2025.

ADJOURNMENT  Council  Member  Hurtado  unanimously  motioned  to adjourn  the meeting
  at 6:02 p.m. and seconded  by Council  Member  Avalos.

PASSED  and APPROVED  on this 24"  day of February  2026.

  ATTEST:

  Yodit  G  , City  Clerk
